source: Local development build, synthetic Untitled Presentation. Crops show the original interface; only cropping, resizing and WebP encoding were applied. The recordings linked in the listening section are separate takes.

captures.alt: Artwork toolbar showing Music Studio beside Templates
captures.caption: Music Studio opens from the artwork toolbar.

captures.alt: Open style menu listing Chill House, Rock and Classical Piano below Retro 8-bit
captures.caption: The menu shows the three styles together. A checkmark identifies the current selection.

captures.alt: Chill House selected at 116 BPM with 4 bars and Local Pattern Model selected, Generate Music available and Preview dimmed
captures.caption: With a style selected, Generate Music is available. Preview and Add to Scene become available after generation.

captures.alt: Chill House take Midnight Crossing showing Stop Preview, 116 BPM, 8.3 seconds and six instruments
captures.caption: In this iPad take, Midnight Crossing plays at 116 BPM with sub bass, electric piano and a light snare.

captures.alt: Rock take Velvet Echo showing Stop Preview, 112 BPM, 8.6 seconds and overdriven guitar
captures.caption: Velvet Echo plays at 112 BPM. The instrument list includes toms, electric bass and overdriven guitar.

captures.alt: Classical Piano take Solar Field showing Stop Preview, 76 BPM, 12.6 seconds and acoustic piano
captures.caption: Solar Field plays at 76 BPM. Acoustic piano is the only instrument in this take.

captures.alt: Scene Details with Solar Field as the third timeline lane below Welcome and Orb, from 0.0 to 12.6 seconds
captures.caption: After Add to Scene, Solar Field appears as an audio lane beneath the two artwork layers.
